core_obligations: Say T = V(g_1, ..., g_s); after replacing g_j by powers, multiplication by g_j is zero on F (carded input).
Choose E on X lifting F with the g_j restricting to zero on U (declared lifting input).
Iterate: C_{i+1} = cone(g_i: C_i -> C_i); by the two Derived Categories lemmas the restriction computes F + F[1]^{+s} + F[2]^{binomial(s,2)} + ... + F[s] and each g_j squares to zero on the cones.
Choose beta, gamma: C' -> C_s as in the lifting lemma with beta|_U an isomorphism and gamma beta^{-1} the projection killing the F-summand; C' = C_s tensor^L I remains perfect and supported on T.
Cone(gamma) restricts on U to F + F[1]; conclude.
proof_roadmap: Nilpotence reduction; lift with shift; iterated cone computation with binomial multiplicities; map lifting with prescribed restriction; cone finish.
difficulty_reason: An iterated cone construction with binomial multiplicity bookkeeping plus a two-map lifting trick; every step is carried.
